props.name: children
props.comment: Shown only while this component holds the lock.

props.name: id
props.comment: Defaults to the id of the record context.

props.name: identity
props.comment: Defaults to the auth provider's identity.

props.name: loading
props.comment: Shown while the lock is requested. Defaults to a `Skeleton`.

props.name: lockedBy
props.comment: Shown when another identity holds the lock. Defaults to an `Alert` naming the holder.

props.name: onLockError
props.comment: Called with a failed lock or release. A new function every render never relocks.
